description: Re-key a page by slug (draft or published static), server-side hash copy. Default deletes static routes; movePath:true repoints the route, rewrites menu refs, redirects and root-relative / {slug}.dotsy.site hrefs in draft HTML (as rename_page), and for an already-published page leaves a 301 (leaveRedirect, default true). Retry-safe: 409 rename_failed rolls back, resend. On fragments/<name>.html it also rewrites every <dotsy-fragment name> reference and hide marker in one commit. Then publish_site.

leaveRedirect.description: With movePath:true on an already-published page, leave a 301 at the old path (default true). false removes the old path outright — old links break. No effect when movePath is false, or on a page that was never published.

movePath.description: false (default): delete routes bound to old key. true: move static route path to match slug.

newSlug.description: New filename stem; directory prefix preserved (blog/foo → blog/bar)

name: rename_content
